verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a native Risk Register that replaces spreadsheets and supports scoring in a 4×4 or 5×5 risk matrix. Users can track, evaluate and remediate risks, and a dedicated role manages its assigned risks, including the controls and action items linked to them. That covers scoring, owners, treatment via action items, and ties back to controls. missing for 10: documented periodic risk review cycles or reminders (the review reminders in the evidence belong to access reviews, not risks), detailed first-party docs on treatment-plan structure, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
